Name: Expanded Bush Forage Overhaul
Author: GingerNinja7921
Description:
[u][b]More Bush [/b][/u][b][u]Forage[/u][/b]

[i]Experience an enhanced foraging adventure with the "More Bush Forage" mod. Uncover a diverse array of treasures as you shake off bushes in different seasons. Get ready for a foraging journey like never before!
[/i]
[b][u]Key Features[/u][/b]:
[list]
[*]Seasonal Delights: Explore the wonders of spring, summer, and fall, each offering a unique set of treasures to discover.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Rare Finds: Encounter rare items like the elusive Golden Apple, exotic Breeze Berries, and the sparkling Glistening Sweet Corn.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Varied Textures: Immerse yourself in the visual richness with unique textures for each discovered item, from the luscious Strawberry to the fiery Fire Pepper.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Exciting Chances: The thrill of each shake is amplified with varied chances, adding an element of surprise to every foraging attempt.
[/list]
[b][u]Seasonal Highlights[/u][/b]:
[list]
[*][i]Spring:[/i] Shake off bushes to find treasures such as Golden Apples, Strawberries, and the delightful Pink Cake.
[/list]
[list]
[*][i]Summer:[/i] Explore the season of warmth and discover treasures like Breeze Berries, Blueberries, and the tropical Pineapple.
[/list]
[list]
[*][i]Fall:[/i] Uncover the bounty of autumn with treasures like Cranberries, Wild Plum, and the elusive Pomegranate.
[/list]
A Forager's Paradise: Embark on a foraging journey that spans the seasons, each shake bringing the excitement of uncovering new and rare delights. Upgrade your foraging experience with "More Bush Forage" and turn every shake into a memorable adventure!

NOTE: I got the idea for this mod from the wonderful mod creator [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/100167993]BasiliskL[/url], They gave me permission to use their mod as a template for my mod, Their mod in question is[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15893] *CLICK ME*[/url][b], [/b]be sure to check this out as it's absolutely wonderful. :)

Manifest.Description: Get more foragables from bushes, including some of my own modded items.
